name: Golden Dragon Investments
description: Investing in Hong Kong's future, one race at a time.
story: Golden Dragon Investments is a Hong Kong-based private equity firm focused on emerging technologies and high-growth companies in the region. Recognizing the growing popularity of motorsport in Asia, they see sponsorship as a valuable tool for brand building and talent development within Hong Kong. They seek to partner with teams and drivers who demonstrate a commitment to excellence and represent the dynamism of the Hong Kong spirit.
